name: patient_id
description: Patient ID, MRN, Hospital ID, or HS No

name: hospital_name
description: Name of the hospital or medical centre

name: diagnosis
description: Primary diagnosis, medical conditions, or reason for admission

name: doctor_name
description: Name of the primary attending consultant or doctor

name: procedures
description: Medical procedures, surgeries, or interventions performed

name: medications
description: List of prescribed medications, dosages, or discharge drugs

name: total_bill_amount
description: Total hospital inpatient final bill amount in rupees (not small retail pharmacy bills)

name: amount_paid
description: Amount paid or deposited by patient towards hospital bill in rupees

name: insurance_company
description: Name of the health insurance company or TPA (e.g. ICICI Lombard, Star Health). Do NOT extract pharmacy names or codes.

name: policy_number
description: Health insurance policy number. Do NOT extract pharmacy or drug license numbers.

name: claim_number
description: Insurance claim number, CCN, or cashless authorization letter (AL) number

name: claim_amount
description: Insurance authorized, approved, or claimed settlement amount in rupees
